<$voicel(4,5)>Huh, you’re a new face. <$emotion(4,29)>What’s your deal?
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Goin’ around buildin’ towns and hopin’ more Pokémon’ll
show up? Dang...

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,4)>That’s super rad! But, uh... You gonna be OK with those
floppy noodle arms? No offense.

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>“Probably” doesn’t exactly inspire confidence, pal...
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,816)>All right, lemme tell ya about a real good training spot I
know around here.

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,816)>Well, you lucked out—I know a great training spot around
here, and I’m feeling generous today.
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>I’ll take ya there now. Follow me!
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,53)>Over here—follow me!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>As you can tell, this spot’s surrounded by super solid sand.
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,814)><$comeff(4,5)>And lemme tell ya, punchin’ the stuff with all your might
is an equally solid workout!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,806)>Of course, a single punch is all it takes for a powerhouse
like me to pulverize that sand into dust.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>Don’t worry—you’ll get there someday. Until then, you
oughta train here.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, and be sure to clean up after yourself. No leavin’ a
sandy mess for others, got it? That’s just common decency.
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>It might take a few decades, but if ya manage to bring me
<$cdef(27)>six <$ifull(1010)> someday, <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,38)>I’ll be impressed!

<$voicel(4,5)>Sure, ya can’t use sand for anything... <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)>But ya can’t throw it
away! That’s just common sense.

Actually, you CAN use <$cdef(27)>sand—by melting it down to
make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(108)>.
So try collecting <$cdef(27)>sand! It’s sure to come in handy!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,806)>And good on ya for pickin’ up after yourself! It’s too bad
sand’s totally useless, huh?

Apologies for the repetition, but there actually IS a way to
use <$cdef(27)>sand.
You can light a fire in a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1446)>, then put
<$cdef(27)>sand in it to make <$cdef(27)><$ifull(108)>!
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(108)> can be a useful building material.

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,40)>Oh, hey! Since you’re clearly a genius, maybe you could
help me out...
<$voicel(4,6)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Sorry to ask, but could ya come with me for a sec?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,8)>If you can climb up to the top here, there’s a dojo just a
short walk away.
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, a dojo’s like, uh...y’know. A place where humans train
and stuff. <$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>I love spendin’ time there.

it’s totally busted now.

<$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,666)>So I was wonderin’... Could ya maybe fix up the <$cdef(27)>elevator
<$comeff(4,6)>so folks can get to it?
